outcome: Association between breast milk microbiome and infant gut microbiome
cohort: 189 mother-infant dyads enrolled in the New Hampshire Birth Cohort Study
finding: Breast milk microbiome types were associated with infant gut microbiome types at 6 weeks of age, particularly in infants delivered by Cesarean section, and milk microbial communities were more strongly associated with infant gut communities at later time points (e.g., 6-week milk microbiome with 6-month infant gut microbiome).
mod_finding: The association between breast milk microbiome and infant gut microbiome at 6 weeks was stronger among infants delivered by Cesarean section.
followup_time: 6 weeks, 4 months, 6 months, 9 months, and 12 months
